usage.title: Usage & cost
usage.empty: No usage recorded in this period. It appears after your first turn.
usage.footnote: Cost is the billed value returned with each turn. It is not the /cost number on the chat page — that one is current context size; this is cumulative spend. "Input" excludes cache; cached tokens are under "Cache read" (billed at about a tenth). Token counts recorded before the hj release are incomplete — the gateway reports usage at the end of the stream, which older versions missed; costs are unaffected.
